ios.desc:
Promptty is a native prompt manager for people who reuse AI prompts every day. Keep prompts, templates, instructions, workflows, and reusable text organized on iPhone, iPad, and Mac — then insert them from the Promptty keyboard without digging through notes, chats, docs, or screenshots.

WHY PROMPTTY

Paste from the keyboard
Open the Promptty keyboard in any app, search your library, and insert the prompt you need.

Build a real prompt library
Organize prompts with custom categories, colors, icons, and tags so your best workflows are easy to find.

Search everything fast
Find prompts by title, content, category, or tag.

Sync with iCloud
Keep your prompt library available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. No extra account required.

Share prompts
Create public prompt links when you want to share a reusable prompt with someone else.

Private by default
Your prompts stay on your device and in your personal iCloud. Promptty doesn’t see, store, or analyze your prompt content.

USE PROMPTTY FOR

• System prompts and reusable AI instructions
• Writing, marketing, and social templates
• Code review, debugging, and documentation prompts
• Research workflows and analysis frameworks
• Any text you paste often and don’t want to rewrite

HOW IT WORKS

1. Save your favorite prompts
2. Organize them with categories and tags
3. Search from the app or Promptty keyboard
4. Paste the right prompt wherever you’re working

START FREE

Use Promptty with 10 prompts for free. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited prompts and advanced workflow features.

Built natively for the Apple ecosystem.

---

Built with love for the Apple ecosystem. Native SwiftUI. No subscriptions required for basic use.
